description:
Changes a report definition (RDL, RDLC) given as its XML by operations (the SSRS2 designer's own), all or none. The text is patched (the rest as it was), then checked: its new problems and pages said. The answer's rdlc is the changed report (past 200 KB, url and curl: a download within ten minutes).
Operations ("op"): dataset, parameter, page, header, footer, code, textbox, table, matrix, list, chart, gauge, indicator, databar, sparkline, image, barcode, qrbill, subreport, line, rectangle, set, remove, space, move, swap, copy, field, column, remove_column, row, total, group, sort, widths, filter, restyle, palette. A new item goes "after"/"before" an item or a role (role:signature), in a container or at [x, y] cm. help: ["textbox","set"]: their words.

edits.description: Or exact replacements: [{find, replace, in?, all?}].

fit.description: With keepPages: a block that costs rows is written in the form checked to keep them.

keepPages.description: Refuse a change that would print more pages, or at fewer table rows (variants, rowCounts too).

maxPages.description: Refuse a report printing more pages.

pictures.description: Pictures an image names by its file: {"path": "<base64>"}.

rewrite.description: Write anew a report that cannot be patched.

name: edit_report
title: Change a report
